name: Registry Run Key Persistence via Suspicious Directory
description: Detects a new value added to a Run/RunOnce registry key pointing to an executable staged in a world-writable or unusual directory.
query: registry.key:("*\\CurrentVersion\\Run" OR "*\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce") AND registry.value:("C:\\Users\\Public\\*" OR "C:\\ProgramData\\*" OR "C:\\Windows\\Temp\\*")
